title: Say in the MCP `done` word's description that explicit links are refused under an evaluated acceptance policy
outcome: Say in the MCP `done` word's description that explicit links are refused under an evaluated acceptance policy
acceptance: The MCP `done` tool description (and the CLI `done --help`) states that under an evaluated acceptance policy `links` are not accepted and the evaluation's citations link the criteria, matching what `show` already prints ("evaluated: done takes no --link")
